notes: Settings you can shape. A switch at the top of Settings shows the essentials or everything. Appearance: surface (black, pure black, graphite), text size, font, motion, card size and corners, what shows under posters. Home: where the featured board draws from and how often it changes, Continue Watching as art or posters, its order, whether episodes that are not out yet count, row sublines, wide cards, cast and genres on title pages. Playback: when the next episode is offered and how long the countdown runs, a still-watching check, resume or ask or start over, the skip step, starting speed, a resolution cap, preferred audio and subtitle languages with a second choice, subtitles at start, bold subtitles, the clock, the pause board and how fast controls hide. Streams: order, minimum quality, details, badges, how the add-on is marked, and playing the best stream by itself with a wait for slow add-ons. Add-ons can be switched off without removing them. Advanced: fast row scrolling on TV, the welcome message, reset all settings, clear caches.
